interpretation.natural_shape_hypothesis: 80-byte mutable lastFileName buffer followed by 307 eight-byte records and a count-zero terminator; each record is {kind/element width, count, far pointer}. This declaration shape is supported by consumers and the isolated C7 OMF probes, but source object boundaries and original spelling remain provisional.
positive_classes: The root provenance first 50 rows are reproduced and extended through count-zero using original NE relocation semantics and exact MAPSYM pointer names.

Every candidate with a sentinel emits an 80-byte all-zero name span, all 307 observed record fields at eight-byte stride, 307 four-byte far-pointer fixups with matching named owners, and a zero-count terminator; its SIMANT_DATA_GROUP contribution is 2544 bytes.

Mutable versus const table declarations and {0} versus empty-string buffer initialization have identical OMF object/data identity under this profile, so these object observations do not identify the original source spelling or mutability.
negative_classes: The no-sentinel declaration emits only 2536 bytes and lacks the observed terminator; it is negative as a complete standalone model, while a separate following object remains possible.
The assumption that the table ends at root prefix offset 0x9700 is contradicted by count=1 at 0x9702 and 257 further records before the terminator.
placement_and_extent_caveats: The 0x9520..0x956F zero span is observed and referenced by filename routines, but its source object/class/boundary is not independently established.

The candidate 2544-byte contribution would span 0x9520..0x9F10 if based at 0x9520; this placement is hypothetical. The next named symbol at 0x9F20 gives an observed upper bound with an unassigned 16-byte gap, not proof of a source object boundary.
NE relocation-chain storage is loader metadata. Only semantic target segment and exact MAPSYM owner were used; raw chain words were not interpreted as source data or constants.
interpretation.execution_control_flow: Disassembly-based source hypothesis: records have an eight-byte stride; consumers use the first two words to calculate transfer bytes, process each pointer in per-record file I/O loops, and use the following record count==0 as the loop terminator. SaveGame includes a preflight total-size calculation before writing; LoadGame has analogous size accumulation and read processing. This is a semantic hypothesis, not a strict function match.
interpretation.strict_admission: No grind.py test/accept/block, strict function attempt, or production reissue was performed. No recovery credit is claimed.

original_region_omf_comparison.scope: Isolated OMF versus original DATA segment comparison; no job state changed.
original_region_omf_comparison.comparison_interpretation: All bytes outside the candidate 307 four-byte far-pointer OMF fixups match the original window exactly. The NE image encodes each corresponding far pointer as a two-byte offset plus a two-byte loader-chain relocation; compare semantic target names/segment+offset, not raw chain bytes.
scope_limits: The base at 0x9520 and 2544-byte object contribution are hypotheses, not established original ownership or TU boundaries.
This comparison does not prove source field names, type spelling, mutability or initializer spelling.
No strict function comparison or grind state change was performed.

consumer_evidence.direct_vs_inferred: The machine code directly steps by eight, multiplies word0 and word1, passes words +4/+6 to file I/O, and stops when the following record word+2 is zero. Naming word0 element width/kind and word1 count, and identifying the span at 0x9520 as a source-level filename object, remain inferences.
